title: Reliability standards for AI data centers, crypto miners move closer to adoption

meta.summary: The proposed rules must still be approved by NERC’s board and federal regulators. As written, they would apply to computational loads of 50 MW or more, connected at voltage levels of at least 100 kV.

title: PJM plans to study SoftBank’s Ohio AI project under state agreement approach

meta.summary: The project,   dubbed “Flagship,” includes 765-kV transmission lines to be built by AEP Ohio, roughly 10 GW in data center load and about 10.2 GW in gas-fired generation.

title: Northwest Cautiously Awaits BPA’s ‘Open Season’ Proposal

meta.summary:
Stakeholders responded with cautious optimism to the Bonneville Power Administration’s proposal to connect large loads to the grid faster through an open season process, with the Public Power Council saying money shouldn’t be the only determinant of who gets transmission. 
 The post  Northwest Cautiously Awaits BPA’s ‘Open Season’ Proposal  appeared first on  RTO Insider .

title: State-regulated IRP Model Superior for Democratic Accountability, Consumer Protection

meta.summary:
Former FERC Chair Mark Christie says that keeping responsibility for the all-important electric power grid at the state level best serves democratic accountability, and that means best serving the people who pay the bills. 
 The post  State-regulated IRP Model Superior for Democratic Accountability, Consumer Protection  appeared first on  RTO Insider .

title: National Ramifications Seen in Ohio AEP Tariff Suit

meta.summary:
The Ohio Supreme Court is weighing an industry group’s challenge to the American Electric Power data center tariff that Ohio utility regulators approved in 2025.

title: A new class of batteries helps data centers play nicely with the grid

meta.summary: Lithium-ion batteries could do so much for AI data centers and the power grid.
